recent_events.note: CME first seen in white light imagery to the E in GOES CCOR-1 starting at 2026-11-05T20:00Z. In real time, this CME is covered by data gaps in SOHO LASCO and STEREO A COR2. The source of this CME is like related to an M3.5 class flare from AR 14566 (S08E35) which peaked at 2026-11-05T18:33Z. The flare is best seen in SDO AIA 131. Some post-eruptive dimming can also be seen in SDO AIA 193. Due to the source location being in close proximity to a coronal hole, some deflection is likely.

cmeAnalyses.note: Preliminary measurement based only on running difference imagery from GOES CCOR-1. recent_events.note: CME seen to the east in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and GOES CCOR-1 imagery. The CME is also faintly visible to the east in STEREO A COR2 after a data gap from 2026-11-05T14:35Z to 2026-11-06T01:38Z. Moving/opening field lines are also best seen in SDO AIA 171/193 imagery.

cmeAnalyses.note: This measurement is based on the best fit between STEREO A COR2, SOHO LASCO C2/C3, and GOES CCOR-1 imagery in SWPC_CAT as well as the potential source location.
